data.similarity_reason: Bachatt builds fintech software for the same customer base as the target: India's 300 Mn merchants, self-employed and small business owners (shopkeepers, dealers, manufacturers), offering savings, wealth and working-capital credit tools alongside payments-adjacent financial services.
data.partner_evidence: Press release quotes Pratik Agarwal, Partner, Accel, on the Series A investment.
data.contact_evidence: Official Bachatt press release lists media contact: Minni Singh, MedioX Marketing & Communications, +91 8595697877 (email-protected on page).
data.evidence_summary: Official Bachatt press release dated 30 March 2026: AI-led savings & wealth platform for middle India raised USD 12M Series A led by Accel, with participation from existing investors Lightspeed and Info Edge Ventures; serves shopkeepers, dealers, manufacturers and business owners.

data.similarity_reason: Bengaluru-based B2B cross-border payments platform serving ~15,000 SaaS companies, GCCs, ITeS exporters and freelancers — same India fintech payments-software-for-businesses category as the startup data.
data.partner_evidence: In the announcement, Alex Tran is quoted as 'Managing Director, General Catalyst': 'At General Catalyst, we believe the next wave of global fintech infrastructure will be built in India - and Xflow is one of the companies leading that charge... We're excited to continue backing Anand, Ashwin, Abhijit and the Xflow team.' Confirms Tran as the General Catalyst partner on the deal.

data.evidence_summary: Company press release dated 2026-02-23: Xflow raised $16.6M in a Series A round led by General Catalyst, with Square Peg, Stripe, Lightspeed and Moore Capital participating and PayPal Ventures joining as a new investor, at an $85M post-money valuation.

data.similarity_reason: B2B fintech SaaS company building banking, lending and treasury/payments infrastructure software that banks, NBFCs and super apps use to serve business customers; comparable as an India Series A fintech selling payments-adjacent financial software to business-facing financial institutions.
data.partner_evidence: Accel's official portfolio page for Knight Fintech lists Initial Investment 'series a' and Partner Rachit Parekh, identifying the Accel partner who covers/led the investment.
data.contact_evidence: Knight FinTech's official homepage links a 'Contact Us' page (knightfintech.com/contact-us/) as the public route to reach the company.
data.evidence_summary: Inc42 weekly funding report: On 2 Jan 2026, fintech SaaS startup Knight FinTech announced a $23.6 Mn Series A funding round led by Accel, with participation from IIFL, Rocket Capital, Prime Ventures, 3one4 Capital, Commerce VC and Trifecta Capital.

data.similarity_reason: Skydo builds cross-border payments software for Indian MSMEs, freelancers and exporters (multi-currency collections, invoicing, compliance), matching the India fintech/payments-software-for-small-businesses profile.
data.contact_evidence: Skydo's official contact page gives its Bengaluru HQ address (HSR Layout) and links to its sales and support channels, providing a public route to reach the company.
data.evidence_summary: Skydo's official blog post dated 10 December 2025 announces a Series A round led by Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital with participation from Elevation Capital and Eximius Ventures; the $10 million funds scaling of Skydo's RBI-authorised cross-border payments platform for Indian exporters (30,000+ MSMEs, 32+ currencies).

data.similarity_reason: Like the seed (India, Series A, fintech software for businesses), BeyondSquare sells B2B finance software: FinAlyzer automates financial close, consolidation, multi-GAAP statutory reporting and compliance analytics for enterprise finance/CFO teams across 45+ countries.
data.contact_evidence: BeyondSquare's official site (beyondsquare.com, hosting the FinAlyzer product) links its contact page at finalyzer.ai/contact-us/ for product and business enquiries.
data.evidence_summary: BeyondSquare Solutions, the Bengaluru company behind FinAlyzer, raised US$4 million in a Series A round led by Avant Global Corporation, announced 2025-09-17. Proceeds strengthen FinAlyzer's automation, compliance intelligence and scalability for enterprises with complex reporting structures, and expand its footprint in the Middle East, Europe and Southeast Asia. Entrackr confirms the $4M Series A led by Avant Global, executed in three stages (new/convertible shares, existing-shareholder subscriptions, warrant conversion).

data.contact_evidence: RTP Global's official website contact page (https://rtp.vc/contact) is the firm's public enquiry route for deal and general contacts.
data.evidence_summary: ETBFSI monthly funding report (Jul 7, 2025) states GoKwik, offering checkout optimisation and conversion solutions for e-commerce merchants, raised USD 13 million in June 2025 from RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV Partners, and Think Investments (1lattice data).

data.similarity_reason: Snapmint provides EMI payment solutions for online purchases — India consumer-payments software, a payments-sector comparable though aimed at consumers rather than SMBs.

data.contact_evidence: General Atlantic's official Contact page lists general and media enquiry emails plus the Mumbai office address (Level 19, Birla Aurora, Worli, Mumbai, +91 68 28522000) as public contact routes.
data.evidence_summary: ETBFSI October 2025 funding report states Snapmint, a provider of no-credit-card EMI payment solutions for online purchases, raised USD 125 million from General Atlantic in October 2025.
